title: Ukrainian Bible, translation of Panteleimon Kulish, Ivan Puluj and Ivan Nechui-Levytskyi (1905), full Bible, one verse per line
period: late 19th century (translated 1869-1903, printed 1905), early modern Ukrainian
notes: License: 'public-domain' is stated for translation id 'ukr1871' in the eBible corpus licence table https://github.com/BibleNLP/ebible/blob/2bde52b4c2cfd7056cf4ed07c48969647df79744/metadata/licences.tsv (taken from eBible.org's copyright page, https://ebible.org/ukr1871/copr.htm). The url pins a fixed commit, so the bytes do not change. 6,011,776 bytes; eBible corpus format: one verse per line aligned to a fixed versification (empty lines for verses the translation lacks; '<range>' marks merged verses, a few letters each). vs/refcorpus.normalize(..., 'ukrainian') gives 3,222,031 characters. Replaces the Ohiienko text first proposed on this branch, whose public-domain status is doubtful (translator d. 1972); all three translators of this text died before 1920. Combining marks (e.g. the breve of й) are stripped by the generic normalization.
